notes.title: Small bug fix
notes.content: Small bug fix with regard to player outfit customization not working correctly after player death

notes.title: Updated exp table and some more edits to the user interface
notes.content:
*The exp table has now been updated so that it's a bit easier to advance in level

*Some more changes to the user interface

notes.title: Some updates to the user interface
notes.content: Some updates to the user interface

notes.title: Bug fix
notes.content: Fixing bug that had the player character still showing on screen on player death.

notes.title: Bug fix
notes.content: It turns out that a recent update caused bows to stop working, which has now been fixed.

notes.title: New feature: Character customization
notes.content: Adding character customization. Now it's possible to change color of character hair, armor, legs, and boots.

notes.title: Fixing bug with town portal
notes.content: Fixing bug that made so that some areas became inaccessable after using town portal

notes.title: Adding customizable keybinding
notes.content: Adding customizable keybinding

notes.title: Adding progress bar to skillsets
notes.content: Adding progress bars for skilling

notes.title: Fixing bug with amulet of loss
notes.content: Fixing bug regarding amulet of loss not working properly. Also fixing bug that made it possible to continue to eat bread after running out of it.

notes.title: Adding two boss spawns
notes.content: Adding two boss spawns: Alaric, a human melee fighter who also has a very high magic knowledge, and Zyrmaruk, a minotaur who also he fights using both melee and magic. Both of these will result in an achievement by defeating them!

notes.title: Adding food container to UI
notes.content: Now instead of putting food in the main backpack container in order to carry it food is dropped into a food container at the user interface

notes.title: Small bug fix
notes.content: Fixing issue with attack target on monster not being removed automatically upon player death

notes.title: Performance update 2
notes.content: Game now loads faster at start-up

notes.title: Performance update
notes.content: Game now runs smoother in spawns

notes.title: Minor fixes
notes.content: Minor fixes

notes.title: Fixing bug with damage done on monsters not showing
notes.content: Fixing bug with damage done on monsters not showing

notes.title: More details to the village and adjacent area and outline to game text font
notes.content:
*Added details to the village and its adjacent area
*Text outline has been added to game text font
*Highscore list removed, will maybe be added again at a later time

notes.title: Fixing bug that came with previous update of the game
notes.content: Fixing bug with player not receiving exp from monsters that came with the previous update of the game.

notes.title: Improvement of loading time at start-up of the game
notes.content: In this latest version the loading time for the start-up of the game has been somewhat reduced.

notes.title: Small changes
notes.content:
*Some changes to the skilling table, making it a little easier to advance in skills
*Some changes to loot drop rate

notes.title: Small changes
notes.content:
*Easier to remove binded hotkey
*Increased number of monsters in a couple of spawns
